text:
Three AI labs shipped flagship models this week. Here's the only filter you need.

What changed: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra, Anthropic dropped Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1, and Google pushed Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber — all inside the same seven days.

What it actually does: three different bets on the same problem. Astra leans into agentic workflows. Fable and Mythos split into a fast tier and a deeper reasoning tier. Flash Cyber trades some depth for near-instant multimodal speed.

Why builders should care: picking the "best" model by leaderboard is a trap. Picking the right model for the job in front of you is the actual skill, and it's the one nobody teaches you in a demo video.

Try this this week: before you open any chat, name the job first — deep reasoning, fast iteration, or cheap high-volume — then pick the model for that job, not the one trending on your feed.

The bigger signal: the model war stopped being about who's smartest. It's about who fits your actual workflow.
